LEFT switch panel radio group. WRITE lights the one indicator whose radio index equals the value and extinguishes the others; READ carries the pressed button's index. The counterpart of Sys001Skin001 which the panel firmware uses for the RIGHT panel: before this cell existed both boards decoded Sys001Skin001 and the left board's indices 1-6 aliased the right board's HOME..FX MUTE so a press on either arrived identically and no test could tell them apart (S120-1 / PW ruling (a) 2026-09-27)

Console talkback button and its two indicators on the RIGHT switch panel (TB_SW / TB_LED0 / TB_LED1 through H1S3; before this cell they passed through the panel processor with no matrix cell bound at all so the host could neither read the switch nor light the indicators - catalog row 92 NOT TESTED). WRITE is the two-indicator mask: bit0 = TB_LED0 bit1 = TB_LED1 so 0 = both dark 3 = both lit. READ is the switch: 1 while it is held 0 when it is released and both edges are reported. The write and the read carry different meanings on one cell exactly as Sys001Skin001 does (PW ruling / S129 addendum 7 2026-09-27)
